name: fantasy-mcp
description: Read-only access to your ESPN fantasy football team, matchup, free agents, and players.

espn_s2.title: espn_s2 cookie
espn_s2.description: From your browser's cookies for espn.com while logged in to ESPN. See README: Get your ESPN cookies.

swid.title: SWID cookie
swid.description: Same place as espn_s2. Keep the curly braces.

league_id.title: League ID
league_id.description: The leagueId=... number in your league's URL on fantasy.espn.com.

season.title: Season (optional)
season.description: Defaults to the current calendar year. Set it during Jan-Jul to keep looking at last season.

team_id.title: Team ID (optional)
team_id.description: Leave blank to auto-detect your team from your SWID.
